Congress Objects to IPS Officer's Speech at Right-Wing Event

The Congress party has raised objections regarding an Indian Police Service (IPS) officer's speech. The speech was delivered at an event organized by a Hindu right-wing organization. This incident highlights concerns about the perceived neutrality of government officials when participating in events hosted by politically aligned groups.
